note: Prototype narrative catalogs for Screen 04. Not STA 2E mechanics (Core Rulebook p. 216). Events and honors are multi-select; reputation is one or none. No mechanical bonuses.

events.name: First Contact
events.summary: First contact with an unknown civilization
events.description: The ship established first contact with a previously unknown people or polity.
events.background: Contact protocols and careful shows of peaceful intent shaped the encounter.
events.significance: It can redefine maps, alliances, and the ship's place in Starfleet lore.
events.implications: Later missions may bring follow-up diplomacy—or suspicion from powers that prefer a quiet frontier.

events.name: Rescue Operation
events.description: The crew executed a dangerous rescue while lives hung in the balance.
events.background: Speed, coordination, and accepted risk defined the operation.
events.significance: Marks the ship as a vessel that answers distress when it matters most.
events.implications: Allies may seek this registry in a crisis; adversaries may test that reputation.

events.name: Major Scientific Discovery
events.description: Shipboard science produced a discovery of lasting research value.
events.background: Sensors, labs, and field teams went beyond routine survey duty.
events.significance: Adds scholarly prestige without rewriting the ship's mechanical profile.
events.implications: Science missions and requests to revisit the discovery site may follow.

events.name: Border Incident
events.description: The ship was drawn into a tense confrontation along a disputed border.
events.background: Incomplete intelligence and rival claims turned a patrol into a crisis.
events.significance: Reminds others that this vessel has stood watch where politics turn sharp.
events.implications: Diplomatic fallout or renewed scrutiny of the ship's log are plausible story beats.

events.name: Diplomatic Breakthrough
events.summary: Talks that broke a long deadlock
events.description: Negotiations hosted or supported by the ship broke a stubborn diplomatic impasse.
events.background: Patience, protocol, and credible neutrality mattered as much as firepower.
events.significance: Associates the registry with careful mediation rather than force.
events.implications: Future assignments may favor escorts, treaty talks, or tense summits.

events.name: Emergency Evacuation
events.description: The ship helped evacuate civilians or crew from catastrophe.
events.background: Overloaded decks, triage, and hard choices shaped the operation.
events.significance: Reinforces a reputation for putting people ahead of convenience.
events.implications: Relief work, survivor follow-ups, and unfinished evacuations may recur.

events.name: Historic Exploration
events.description: The ship charted a region or phenomenon that became part of Starfleet lore.
events.background: Long surveys and incomplete charts preceded a discovery that earned a lasting name.
events.significance: Places the vessel among explorers remembered for what they found.
events.implications: Return expeditions, naming disputes, or second-look hazards can drive later episodes.

events.name: Major Systems Failure
events.description: A cascading systems failure tested the crew's ingenuity and resolve.
events.background: Battle damage, experiment, or misfortune forced improvisation under pressure.
events.significance: A scar on the record that also proves the ship and crew endured.
events.implications: Technical quirks, crew trauma, or skepticism about readiness can color later missions.

reputations.name: Distinguished
reputations.description: The ship is widely respected for consistent excellence in the field.
reputations.background: A string of competent, high-visibility missions built this standing.
reputations.significance: Others expect professionalism and measured judgment from this registry.
reputations.implications: Preferred for sensitive work—but mistakes draw higher scrutiny.

reputations.name: Dependable
reputations.summary: Gets the mission done without drama
reputations.description: Known for getting the mission done without unnecessary drama.
reputations.background: Quiet competence and crews that finish what they start.
reputations.significance: A workhorse reputation: valued, not always celebrated.
reputations.implications: Trusted for support—and sometimes overlooked or overused.

reputations.name: Pioneering
reputations.description: Associated with firsts, experiments, and uncharted work.
reputations.background: New systems, routes, or methods link the ship to innovation—and risk.
reputations.significance: Suggests curiosity and appetite for the unknown.
reputations.implications: Sought for pathfinding; blamed if experiments go wrong.

reputations.name: Diplomatic
reputations.summary: Favored for talks and careful escorts
reputations.description: Favored for talks, escorts, and careful representation of the Federation.
reputations.background: Success in high-protocol environments shaped how others see the ship.
reputations.implications: Welcome at summits—yet every misstep becomes a diplomatic incident.

reputations.name: Formidable
reputations.description: Spoken of with caution in contested space.
reputations.background: Combat readiness or prevailing under fire created this aura.
reputations.implications: Adversaries may hesitate; allies may expect escalation.

reputations.name: Controversial
reputations.summary: Still argued about in the fleet
reputations.description: Decisions made under this registry still draw argument.
reputations.background: A contested tactical, ethical, or political call left the name polarizing.
reputations.implications: Some want that boldness; hearings and distrust may follow.

reputations.name: Unproven
reputations.summary: Too new or too quiet to judge
reputations.description: Too new or too quiet for a settled reputation.
reputations.background: Little public record, a fresh commission, or quiet assignments.
reputations.significance: A blank slate: opportunity and doubt in equal measure.
reputations.implications: Fewer preconceptions—and harder to win discretionary support.

honors.name: Starfleet Commendation
honors.description: A formal Starfleet commendation entered for outstanding service.
honors.background: Awarded when performance exceeds expected standards on a named mission or tour.
honors.significance: A clear mark of recognition in the ship's ceremonial record.
honors.implications: May open doors socially or politically; no mechanical effect.

honors.name: Distinguished Exploration Citation
honors.background: Recognizes charting, discovery, or endurance on the frontier.
honors.significance: Links the ship to Starfleet's exploratory mandate.
honors.implications: Useful color for science and survey stories; no mechanical benefit.

honors.name: Scientific Achievement Award
honors.description: Recognized for scientific contribution while underway.
honors.background: Labs, sensors, and analysis that advanced Starfleet knowledge.
honors.implications: May attract research partners; narrative only.

honors.name: Humanitarian Service Citation
honors.description: Honored for relief, rescue, or aid to civilians.
honors.background: Disaster response, medical support, or evacuation under hardship.
honors.significance: Affirms care for the vulnerable as Federation service.
honors.implications: Story hooks around survivors and unfinished aid; no mechanical effect.

honors.name: Diplomatic Excellence Citation
honors.description: Cited for diplomacy that advanced lasting peace or understanding.
honors.background: Negotiations or careful representation that avoided unnecessary conflict.
honors.significance: Frames the ship as an instrument of peace as well as exploration.
honors.implications: Useful for political plotlines; no mechanical effect.

honors.name: Meritorious Service Award
honors.description: Awarded for sustained meritorious performance over a tour or campaign.
honors.background: Consistent excellence across many duties, not a single flashy action.
honors.significance: A steady honor for a steady ship.
honors.implications: Supports a tone of reliability; narrative only.

honors.name: Defense of the Federation Citation
honors.summary: Cited for defense of Federation lives
honors.description: Cited for defense of Federation lives or territory.
honors.background: Combat or interdiction where the ship stood between a threat and those it protected.
honors.significance: Martial recognition that the ship answered when defense was required.
honors.implications: May color how others view the registry; no mechanical effect.
